data.name: Mubajjal
data.gender_notes: Mubajjal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Will Come with Great Signs
data.long_meaning: In Islamic traditions, Mubajjal refers to the Prophet Isa (Jesus) who will return to Earth with significant miracles and signs before the Day of Judgment. This name signifies belief in the Prophets and anticipation of the End Times. The name Mubajjal carries the meaning “The One Who Will Come with Great Signs” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubajjal usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who will come with great signs and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblematic of faith and patience, Mubajjal reminds us of the coming of the Prophets and the promise of the Last Day.
data.etymology: Mubajjal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Will Come with Great Signs.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubajjal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مبجل
in_arabic.meaning: الشخص الذي يتمتع بجلالة و عظمة في قلوب الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبجل هو الشخص الذي يتمتع بجلالة و عظمة في قلوب الناس، و يلهم الاحترام و التقدير في نفوسهم، و هذا الاسم مشتق من الجلال و العظمة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و الشرف

in_urdu.name: مبجل
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو لوگوں کے قلوب میں عظمت اور جلال رکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبجل وہ شخص ہے جو لوگوں کے قلوب میں عظمت اور جلال رکھتا ہے، اور ان کے نفوس میں احترام اور تقدیر کو प्रेरित کرتا ہے، یہ نام جلال اور عظمت سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ہے جو رفعت اور شرف کے معنی رکھتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुबज्जल
in_hindi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति लोगों के दिलों में महानता और गरिमा रखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबज्जल वह व्यक्ति है जो लोगों के दिलों में महानता और गरिमा रखता है, और उनके मन में सम्मान और प्रशंसा को प्रेरित करता है, यह नाम महानता और गरिमा से लिया गया है, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो उच्चता और प्रतिष्ठा के अर्थ रखते हैं

in_pashto.name: مبجل
in_pashto.meaning: هغه سړی چی په خلکو د زړونو کې عظمت او جلا لری
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبجل هغه سړی دی چی په خلکو د زړونو کې عظمت او جلا لری، او د هغوی په نفوس کې احترام او تقدیر ته الهام ورکوي، دا نوم د جلال او عظمت څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او دا د هغو نومونو څخه دی چی د رفعت او شرف معنی لری

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mubajjal" carries significance in Islamic culture as it signifies the belief in the second coming of Prophet Isa (Jesus) - a Messianic figure venerated in many religions including Christianity, Islam, and others. This belief is clearly stated in the Quran (3:45), and the term "Mubajjal" is often used to refer to this particular return of Prophet Isa. This name serves as a reminder of the prophecies and eschatological expectations shared between Muslim and Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Mubajjal, in its spiritual essence, embodies the hope and belief in the Prophets, their return, and the final days. The reverence towards Prophet Isa as a Messianic figure is deeply rooted in the Islamic faith, fueling spiritual reflection and meditative contemplations. Belief in the return of the Prophets inspires faith in the divine plan, bringing about a suffering and longing among the believers for the return of their saviors.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Mubajjal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Describes Mubajjal as the name of the mount which the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) ascended during the Mi'raj (night journey) to meet Allah and go through various stages of spiritual development.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Ghazali's Ihya Ulum al-Din The name Mubajjal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mubajjal is mentioned in the context of a dream of Caliph Umar ibn Abdulaziz in which he saw the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) on this mount, emphasizing its significance in Islamic spiritual tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Mubajjal' refers to a figure mentioned in Islamic eschatology who is believed to precede the Day of Judgment. He is often described as a fair-skinned, righteous leader who will bring about a period of peace and justice before the end times. In modern context, the figure of Mubajjal has gained significant attention on various Islamic platforms, including social media, forums and websites, and television channels. Discussions around his identity, characteristics, and role in Islamic eschatology have become popular topics, with some claiming that certain individuals or events may be signs of his imminent arrival. Overall, the trending discourse around Mubajjal reflects a growing interest in apocalyptic and end-times beliefs within the Islamic community.
